Un log de puits complet (GR, résistivité: A complete well log (GR, resistivity, density-neutron, sonic) and markers A and B: identify the lithology at depth A, then the reservoir fluid at B (gas, oil or water).
Une coupe sismique générée à partir d'un: A seismic section generated from a real game geology: follow the reservoir top from a tie well to another column, then locate the fault. Blue reflectors mark an impedance increase, red ones a decrease.
Choisissez une carte par facteur du syst: Choose one card per petroleum system factor (trap, reservoir, seal, charge) and play the synergies between them before drilling.
Une description pétrographique s'affiche: A petrographic description is shown, identify the rock among 4 options. Quick, to practise recognition.
Un contexte de profondeur, gradient et e: A depth, gradient and exhumation context is given, guess whether the source rock is immature, in the oil window, or in the gas window.
TOC, indice d'hydrogène, Tmax : entraîne: TOC, hydrogen index, Tmax: practise interpreting these three measurements to judge a source rock's generative potential.
Pilotez un forage de la surface au réser: Steer a well from the surface to the reservoir: weight on bit, rotation, pump, mud density. A kick, a loss of circulation, a sticking or a worn tool may occur: diagnose and fix. Simplified and educational, not an operational procedure.
Choisissez le matériel de forage qui max: Choose the drilling equipment that maximises the expected net gain, or spot the well that stresses its equipment the most. Costs, limits and reliabilities are the game's own, computed on generated blocks.
Impédance, polarité, multiples, taches b: Impedance, polarity, multiples, bright spots, well-seismic tie: practise reading seismic and not falling into traps.
Identifiez les 2 blocs qui vous semblent: Identify the 2 blocks that look like the best prospects on this map and justify each choice in a few words (trap, reservoir, seal, charge: what convinces you about this particular block?). Select a block on the map, then come back here to add it.

Chaque log vient d'un puits tiré au hasa: Each log comes from a randomly drawn well (different basin and seed). The curves: GR in green, resistivity in red (solid line: deep, dotted: shallow), density in red and neutron in dotted blue (yellow marks a crossover), sonic in purple. The left column shows the layers, without their names.
Dans une roche poreuse, une résistivité: In a porous rock, a deep resistivity below 10 Ω·m indicates salt water, above it hydrocarbons. Yellow (neutron clearly below density porosity) tells gas from oil.
Volume d'argile : Vsh = (GR − GR roche p: Clay volume: Vsh = (GR − clean rock GR) / (clay GR − clean rock GR). Density porosity: φ = (ρ matrix − ρb) / (ρ matrix − ρ fluid). Water saturation (Archie, a = 1, m = n = 2): Sw = √(Rw / (φ² × Rt)). Contact: resistivity drops sharply below the hydrocarbon-water contact.
Ces repères sont calibrés sur les puits: These benchmarks are calibrated on the game's wells and each question is chosen so that they settle it: on real logs, ambiguous cases exist (clayey rock, fresh water, poorly saturated gas) and the same curves are debated.
Chaque coupe est tirée d'une vraie géolo: Each section is drawn from a real game geology (different basin and seed). Blue: impedance increases below the reflector, red: it decreases. The thicker the line, the stronger the contrast. A fault shifts all reflectors between two columns at once; a fold tilts them gradually. Distance is not to scale: only depth is quantified.

: 2,03 g/cc = sel gemme, 2,98 = anhydrit: : 2.03 g/cc = rock salt, 2.98 = anhydrite, 1.4 = coal, 2.87 = pure dolomite, 2.71 = pure limestone, 2.65 = pure sandstone. Porosity lowers it.
(plus de 100 µs/ft) : roche très poreuse: (over 100 µs/ft): very porous rock, loose sediments, coal, poorly compacted clay.
énorme (plus de 1 000 Ω·m) sur GR bas et: huge (over 1,000 Ω·m) on low GR and with no porosity: salt or anhydrite. Low (under 5) in a porous rock: salt water. High in a porous rock: hydrocarbons.
